TO APPLICATION: Hyperion
EXTERNAL PARTNER: The Hackett Group
ASSOCIABLE TO TICKET: Yes
PROCESS MANAGER: HFM
LAST UPDATED: 2025-01-02

DESCRIPTION:
Two parallel flows feed data into Hyperion:

HFM (Financial Management):
- User places file in \\de1vs046\TRANSFER\HYPERION\SAPGL_FILE
- Job collects and transforms file into 16-period files
- Sends email confirmation after conversion
- Drops 16 files onto FTP server

PLANNING:
- Collects data from database
- Drops files onto FTP server
- On each run: archives previous files with timestamp
- Archives older than one month are automatically deleted
